description: Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex & Claude Code
notes: Start the proxy with 'ocx start', then open the dashboard at the printed URL (default http://127.0.0.1:10100/).

The bundled web dashboard needs OPENCODEX_GUI_DIST. This manifest points it at the shipped gui/dist, because the upstream standalone binary cannot locate it by itself (it resolves its own path through bun's virtual filesystem).
After upgrading, restart the proxy ('ocx restart') so it picks up the environment variable.
